purpose: Pocket Pilot dashboard design exploration; all displayed figures are fictional.

prompts.overview:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity desktop dashboard design concept for Pocket Pilot, a personal finance tracking product built by Daniel.
Primary request: Create a polished, realistic 1920x1200 landscape screenshot-style UI concept of the ADMIN / MANAGEMENT OVERVIEW, not a personal banking dashboard. Full flat screen, no laptop or device frame, no perspective or decorative objects. Extremely sharp readable labels, disciplined spacing, fine borders, elegant practical enterprise interface.
Brand palette taken from existing app: sage green #5b9279, deep teal #0b4650, pale gray #f0f2f6, white panels, dark charcoal #101011. Small lime #c6ff33 accent only in the Pocket Pilot brand tile. Typography Geist-like clean sans with monospaced numerical values. 224px dark deep-teal left sidebar. Spacious light main canvas.
Left sidebar: a compact PP monogram and 'Pocket Pilot', 'ADMIN WORKSPACE'; navigation 'Overview' selected, 'Traffic & engagement', 'Users', 'Financial accounts', 'Transactions', 'Goals & bills', 'Splitr', 'Feedback', 'Notifications', 'System health'; bottom profile 'Daniel' and 'Owner'.
Top chrome: breadcrumb 'Workspace / Overview', small conspicuous badge 'DESIGN CONCEPT · SAMPLE DATA', top right '01–30 Sep 2026' and timezone 'Mauritius (UTC+4)'.
Page heading 'Platform overview', subtitle 'Growth, adoption and the health of Pocket Pilot.'
Six metric cards in two rows of three with realistic small trend sparklines: 'Registered users' '1,284' footnote 'Current snapshot'; 'Active users · 30 days' '728' footnote 'Distinct users performing a core action'; 'New registrations' '156' footnote 'In selected period'; '7-day activation' '62.1%' footnote 'Account + first entry · matured signup cohorts'; 'Financial accounts' '3,062' footnote 'Existing records'; 'Entries created' '9,846' footnote 'Income, expense and transfer records'.
Below, large left chart titled 'Daily active users', explicitly numbered vertical axis and dated horizontal axis September 1 through 30, sage line and very soft sage area fill. Right a readable horizontal step funnel 'From signup to first value': 'Signed up 140', 'Onboarded 117', 'Added an account 101', 'Recorded an entry 87'; footnote 'Signups with a complete 7-day window'.
Bottom compact horizontal service-health strip 'API errors 0.18%' 'p95 response 240 ms' 'Locked users 8' 'Feedback awaiting review 12'.
Constraints: This is manually recorded finance software. Do not show company revenue, assets under management, payment processing, bank logos, bank sync, credit cards, maps, real customer personal information, fake claims that current backend already supports the metrics, or promotional illustrations. All figures are fictional demonstration data. Small text footer 'Illustrative figures. Analytics and admin permissions are proposed.' Make every text element legible and properly aligned.
prompts.financialAccounts:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: second high fidelity desktop UI concept for Pocket Pilot admin workspace.
Primary request: A crisp practical 1920x1200 flat desktop screenshot of the FINANCIAL ACCOUNTS administration page of the Pocket Pilot personal finance tracking app. Same visual family: 224px deep teal #0b4650 sidebar, sage #5b9279 accents, #f0f2f6 main background, white cards, very thin pale-gray borders, tasteful 10px rounding, Geist-like sans headings and monospaced IDs. The dashboard is about user-created financial tracking records, never imply linked banks or custody of funds. No device frame.
Sidebar PP lime tile, 'Pocket Pilot', 'ADMIN WORKSPACE'. Navigation Overview, Traffic & engagement, Users, Financial accounts (selected), Transactions, Goals & bills, Splitr, Feedback, Notifications, System health. Daniel / Owner at bottom.
Top bar 'Workspace / Financial accounts', conspicuous badge 'DESIGN CONCEPT · SAMPLE DATA'. Heading 'Financial accounts', subtitle 'Understand account adoption across Pocket Pilot.' Period 'Snapshot · 30 Sep 2026'.
Four top cards: 'Existing accounts' '3,062'; 'Account holders' '1,108'; 'Accounts per holder' '2.76'; 'Closed accounts' 'Not tracked' with muted text 'Lifecycle tracking required'. Do not invent closed account counts.
Below left a clean white panel 'Account types' with five precisely labeled horizontal bars Bank 1,460; Savings 760; Wallet 520; Credit 180; Other 142. Right panel 'Currencies' with simple rows 'MUR', 'KES', 'USD', 'GBP' and a caption 'Amounts stay in their original currency'.
Lower full width operations table with search field 'Search account ID or user ID', filter 'All account types', filter 'All currencies'. Columns 'Account ID', 'Holder', 'Type', 'Currency', 'Record state', 'Created'. Rows: ACC-0321 / PP-1042 / Bank / KES / Existing / 08 Sep 2026; ACC-0322 / PP-1043 / Savings / MUR / Existing / 12 Sep 2026; ACC-0323 / PP-1044 / Wallet / USD / Existing / 16 Sep 2026; ACC-0324 / PP-1046 / Credit / GBP / Existing / 18 Sep 2026. All users pseudonymous IDs, no personal contacts or monetary balances.
Small callout footer 'Existing records are not proof of recent activity. Open and closed states need a dedicated account lifecycle.' Small bottom footer 'Illustrative figures · current schema supports account types and currencies'.
Keep all text sharply legible. Realistic compact spacing. Avoid giant illustrations, floating objects, fake bank integrations, real personal data, transaction processing claims, or a personal customer finance screen.
